summary: Repaired reviewed selection gaps. Selection mode now renders a semantic full-row button with aria-pressed and disabled protected roots; normal mode alone renders the BB shortcut/split navigation anchor. Status and trailing chrome are pointer-inert during selection, PR metadata is rendered noninteractive, and child disclosure is disabled, while the checkbox stays above the row target. Updated contract/layout tests, documented superseding decision D-005, and captured live BB proof that status click and Shift+click on trailing time select eligible roots without protected navigation. Dockside tests pass 172/172 and typecheck passes.

state.request: Fix Dockside Shift selection so ordinary click and Shift+click work anywhere on an eligible root thread row while selection mode is active, not only on the checkbox; protected rows must never select or navigate accidentally. Make thread-state icon colors customizable from a Dockside settings page with clear defaults for working, stalled/waiting, unread/waiting-to-read, error, and idle/stale, plus PR review/checks/ready/merged/draft/blocked/closed colors. Add Default, High contrast, and colorblind-friendly presets, reset controls, persistent validated preferences, and additional settings for row density, default child expansion, provider icon visibility, PR metadata visibility, and relative-time visibility. Changes must apply live across the Dockside sidebar, preserve accessible non-color labels/shape/animation, and keep current behavior as defaults.
